oracle: Saved original output_json code and original observed environment for each actual runtime; no lookup from an already replaced wrapper
evidence_per_case: exact input construction and original/candidate source/image identities
complete Python text as code points or exact exception type/message/cause/context/notes
stdout calls and exact returned or raised object identity where relevant

cases.obligation: None, False, True retain their exact text and are classified before integer conversion.
Every U+0000..U+001F, quote and backslash has exact ordinary ensure_ascii=False escaping; no escaped slash is introduced.
ASCII, Latin1, BMP, supplementary code points and every isolated surrogate remain the same Python str code points.
Zero, both signs, uint32 limb boundaries and carries preserve complete decimal text.
Current positive limit below/at/above output length, disabled limit, threshold and early-estimate cases preserve exception timing.
Values around the pinned raw digit-count threshold preserve accepted output and observed failure/limit behavior without introducing a size cap.
Run the complete existing finite formatter method bodies with the actual new image separately identified; do not inherit old results.
NaN payload/sign variants and infinities match allow_nan=True spellings, including negative zero for finite bits.
Integer/float repr overrides are ignored where the original base conversion ignores them; Python-profile float comparison hooks retain their actual order.
Failed status is checked before stale length/output, including short workspace and reuse after success.
Compare actual empty fast paths against subclass bool/len/items/iter overrides separately on each runtime.
Root isinstance __class__ effects and the subsequent actual string-encoder rejection remain distinct.
Python-profile isinstance observations versus nested C raw type flags remain version-specific.
A graph beyond old wire depth128 follows the original runtime recursion behavior rather than a new admission refusal.
Valid strings and nested output larger than old wire bounds are fully compared, not truncated or rejected by a new byte budget.
Shared acyclic containers are encoded at each original occurrence without a global deduplication/collision policy.
List, dict, and default-result cycles retain marker timing and the first original exception.
C profile iterator/length-hint and Python profile truth/iteration are traced independently.
List-size observation and future-element mutation match the actual reference path without a whole-graph snapshot.
items() return list, tuple, iterator and failing iterator follow Mapping_Items versus Python sorted conversion.
Default object __class__/__name__ observation and exception construction preserve the original callback sequence.
A supplied observed encoder-default extension returning another graph preserves marker and recursion order; no custom default is silently added.
Equal-comparing foreign keys force value comparison where full tuple sorting does so; key-only projection is rejected.
Actual incomparable mixed keys fail before value encoding at the same comparison.
NaN and tuple identity-shortcut cases retain original comparison results/order.
Cached richcompare slot, NotImplemented fallback, truth and decref are matched in the full event ledger.
A slot change during earlier comparison preserves fallback selection at later comparisons.
Ascending/descending/equal runs, insertion, galloping and merge-power boundaries match every actual comparison, not only final order.
C two-tuple check and Python two-value unpack occur after original sorting and retain distinct errors.
An items() result list retained by user code appears empty during comparisons on the C no-key sort path.
Aliased-list mutation produces the original mutation error and restores the sorted original permutation.
An existing comparison exception retains priority over later mutation detection; new entries are released in the original order.
Every comparison failure point preserves all items, actual partial permutation and destructor observations.
The current self.cli.output_json lookup and caller result mutation remain visible before later truth evaluation.
A dumps or comparison callback replacing print does not change the already bound print for this invocation.
A callback replacing stdout is observed by the original bound print only after complete serialization.
Observed replacements of json.dumps/JSONEncoder methods are not silently treated as the pinned ordinary algorithm.
Dumps failure performs no print write even when an internal output prefix exists.
Strict, surrogatepass/backslashreplace and failing stdout policies apply at final print, after graph success.
Print return-value discard, None return, write failure and active exception context match the original.
3.14.4 borrowed loop references and 3.14.10 added INCREF/DECREF observations are separate reference traces, never merged.
Items iterator/list/current tuple/keystr/value references are released at the original success and failure phases.
Destructor sys.exception/context/cause during comparison, note formatting and unwind preserves both exception channels.
Failing nested value and foreign key repr in the C error note retain order and exception precedence.
An exception after native return and before observer bookkeeping makes that capability terminal with no effect replay.
Explicit allocation/interrupt controls remain required; identical text alone cannot qualify these traces.

existing_population: Original CLI test module identities are recorded separately in SOURCE-AUDIT.json; no methods are removed, renamed or asserted executed here.
budgets: No new run, altered product deadline, benchmark result or qualification gate is created by this plan.
